skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of business management across various business functions and sectors.
Develop and implement strategic plans for business operations.
Design and optimize organizational structures for effective business operations.
Manage and optimize supply chains and procurement processes.
Understand and manage financial operations and investments in a business context.
Plan and execute marketing strategies and sales activities.
Develop and apply leadership skills in various business contexts.
Implement and manage operational controls within a business.
Work independently and demonstrate discipline in completing tasks.
Collaborate effectively in diverse team settings.
Communicate effectively through group projects and presentations.
Analyze data and solve business problems.
Engage in independent research and continuous learning to adapt to different work environments.
Understand and apply professional ethics and social responsibility.
